Reduction: retained exact source blocks for R3, R9, R12, #PWR01 and their
SPCoast:R / power:+5V cached definitions. Retained root identity, generator,
paper, title-block and embedded_fonts nodes. Removed other items and definitions;
assembled the root/cache wrappers only. No geometry or placement identities
were changed. The project file is an unmodified copy.

The reduced circuit deliberately has six singleton resistor-pin nets. This
exercises preservation that connectivity_sets would omit. Power placement and
opaque embedded definition/presentation content remain part of source gates.
The original design was not edited or automatically re-saved.

Donor behavioral anchors: jBOM/tests/unit/test_annotate_repairs.py Value edits,
multiple attribute edits, missing UUID failures, previews and idempotency.
CSV policy and normalization are not part of this package capability.
